programmes.t: Are You Smarter Than a Fifth Grader?
programmes.d: Elementary students help adults answer questions in subjects ranging from math to social studies. Excited kindergarten teacher, Chrissy Booras, of Hull, MA believes she has what it takes to prove she’s smarter than her fifth grade classmates.

programmes.t: Are You Smarter Than a Fifth Grader?
programmes.d: Astronaut Robert Hoot Gibson has commanded four space shuttle flights and earns shout-outs from Senator John Glenn and Apollo 13 astronaut Jim Lovell. But Houston, commander Gibson might just have a problem proving he is smarter than a 5th grader.
